Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production eight-direction monster animation spritesheet for retro pixel-art isometric RPG. Reference image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE only; make new views and animation poses of precisely this creature. Preserve bone/brass details, anatomy, fur/cloth/shell and palette from reference.
CHARACTER: A corrupted lupine quadruped with charcoal gray-tan fur, higher shoulder hump, jagged broken bone crown behind ears, long ivory claws, a long feathered wolf tail, asymmetric violet fissure on left shoulder, small aged brass binding bands. Maintain quadruped wolf anatomy in every frame.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY EIGHT columns by EIGHT rows, uniform 8x8 invisible grid, 64 full-body sprites, square canvas. EVERY column has ONE fixed screen-facing direction. COLUMN ORDER from LEFT to RIGHT: 1 SOUTH (face toward viewer/down), 2 SOUTHWEST (face down-left), 3 WEST (face left profile), 4 NORTHWEST (back three-quarter up-left), 5 NORTH (full back, face away/up), 6 NORTHEAST (back three-quarter up-right), 7 EAST (face right profile), 8 SOUTHEAST (front three-quarter down-right). Upper camera at 30-degree isometric angle, not top-down. Back views MUST show BACK of head and torso, not a face; left/right lighting stays upper-left, do not just mirror the image.
ROW ORDER is chronological animation frame 1 through 8 top-to-bottom, all eight directions perform SAME phase at each row.
ACTION: IDLE. Rows 1 through 8: relaxed neutral, slight inhale, mid inhale, peak inhale, relax, exhale, cloth/fur settles, near starting pose. Subtle breathing and tail / robe / shell vibration; feet stay grounded. Draw eight successive gentle articulated poses, NO turning between frames.
Every sprite in its own equal-sized cell, same zoom and stable body proportions. Keep virtual ground baseline at 80% cell height and body root centered. Leave transparent safety margin at least 12% on all cell sides, fit horns/crown/tail/claws and collapsed body fully inside its cell. No sprites cross cell boundaries. Crisp deliberately blocky retro pixel clusters, restrained 16-28 colors, dark outlines, upper-left bone-white light, muted iron gray/old cloth, sparse purple corruption cracks, restrained old brass; not smooth painterly concept art or smooth 3D. NO text, no labels, no frame numbers, no grid lines, no UI, no background, no floor, no baked cast shadow. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no drawn checkerboard. Draw 64 sprites, never a concept art collage.
